messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing the camera, then turns his head and upper body to his left, looking down, before turning back to face forward.","camera":"A static, medium close-up shot at eye level, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a small graphic on the lower left chest.","hair_color":"Pink and purple, illuminated by the surrounding neon lights.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair with a top-knot bun and long side-swept bangs covering part of the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young man with a slim build, dark skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"A dark, futuristic interior at night, featuring a large glass window with pink neon framing, a wet reflective floor, and a glowing pink 'TRA' sign in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's wide rear view with a static front medium close-up of the character's face and upper chest. The opening framing closely matches the reference, and the character turns his head/body to his left and then back, roughly preserving the source action progression. The environment is now a dark neon interior with a glass wall and pink 'TRA' sign rather than the source's bright outdoor plaza with a dome and white buildings.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the output environment is intended to be the same location as the source or a newly generated setting.
unexpected_changes: The environment changed from a bright outdoor plaza with a dome and white buildings to a dark neon interior with a glass wall and pink 'TRA' sign.
The character's hair appears pink/purple in the output, while the source hair appears dark.
The character's face is visible in the output, whereas the source showed the character from behind.
